name: phpstats/cmdstanphp
description: A PHP interface to CmdStan inspired by CmdStanR

suggest.ext-ffi: Required for model methods (log_prob, gradients, constrain/unconstrain) and expose_functions()
suggest.ext-phit: Required for loo(moment_match: true): provides the Phit\draws_moments, Phit\draws_covariance_map, and Phit\draws_affine kernels; StanData::fromFormula() also needs its Phit\model_matrix()
suggest.phpstats/phibble: Data frames: pass a Phibble\DataFrame as model data, and get draws and summaries back with draws_table() and summary_table() (PHP 8.5)
